posts.title: Richards Bay terminal loads record chrome cargo
posts.description: Port operations in Durban contrast to the improvements celebrated in Richards Bay, just up the KwaZulu-Natal coast.

posts.title: Continental to close 80-year-old Nelson Mandela Bay tyre plant
posts.description: The potential stoppage would add to a string of plant closures that have hit South Africa’s automotive industry in recent years as manufacturers struggle to compete with surging imports from China and India.

posts.title: Boomers need the youth to get richer
posts.description: Older people in most wealthy countries are losing income ground to working-age households as inflation erodes savings and pensions.
